title: Hot-lane lint: run conformance checklist over L0-L2 in dream Phase 3
description: Extend the dream cycle to lint the hot lane (L0-L2 + hooks + projections), not just the L3 memory substrate. Closes the Phase 1.6 'conformance checklist becomes a procedure' gap: the checklist exists (context-engineering/references/conformance-checklist.md, incl. the regeneration test) but nothing runs it on a schedule. THREE parts: (A) MECHANICAL stack-wide script in infrastructure/tools/ — generalize this repo's lint.sh beyond agent-compounds: L0<=150 lines, CORE<=~200, pointer paths exist, skill-roster-vs-disk, projection symlink/regeneration health, hooks in tracked settings.json, single-source lists vs apps.list. (B) SEMANTIC sweep = new dream/references/stack-lint.md (the L0-L2 analog of lint-checks.md): altitude, no-learnings-in-hot-lane, skill selectability, task-overlap, stale-claims, PLACEMENT-ladder application. (C) WIRING: dream Phase 3 runs A+B, emits GATED proposals to the review queue (L0-L2 changes never auto-apply). Coordinate with the VM/pi Phase-2.v2 work — both touch the dream skill.
